# TALME Technologies

TALME Technologies Pvt Ltd is an engineering-led business services, staffing, managed services, Japan Help Desk, and IT consulting company serving enterprise teams across India, Japan, Singapore, and global delivery markets.

## Japan Help Desk

TALME Japan Help Desk supports companies with Japan market entry, business setup, engineering and technical staffing, recruitment, employer of record support, payroll and HR compliance, business matchmaking, interpreter and translation support, delegation and factory visit coordination, vendor and supply chain identification, and visa and travel assistance.

- Japan Help Desk: https://talme.in/japan-help-desk
- Market Entry & Business Setup: https://talme.in/japan-help-desk/market-entry-business-setup

- Recruitment & Executive Search: https://talme.in/japan-help-desk/recruitment-executive-search
- Employer of Record: https://talme.in/japan-help-desk/employer-of-record-eor
- Payroll & HR Compliance: https://talme.in/japan-help-desk/payroll-hr-compliance
